# Assessment Overview

This document provides a navigation entry point for all supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the application assessment for **ZavaAccountManager**.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer architecture visualization: application architecture (layers, external services, data flow) and component relationships (pages, data access, infrastructure components) |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category, including version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Documentation of service catalog, inbound page surface, outbound HTTP calls to Ledger and AuthGateway, communication patterns, resilience behavior, and security posture |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, inferred entity model (Customers, Accounts, AccountTypes, Transactions), data access methods, and data classification/sensitivity analysis |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, properties, secrets, framework versions, and startup dependencies |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | End-to-end documentation of primary business processes (login, account management, balance/transaction retrieval, open/close account), domain entities, business rules, and decision logic |
